slots_and_copies.name: global_header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy at EEPROM byte 0; validated by FUN_08038348 (magic+sum) and repaired/recreated by FUN_08038830/FUN_080382dc if mismatched. No backup copy exists.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM blocks 3-22 ((0*0x14+3)*8=0x18). Accepted only if FUN_0803880c sum of 80 RAM u16_le == 0 (FUN_08038798); both samples sum !=0 so slot is empty/invalid.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM blocks 23-42 ((1*0x14+3)*8=0xB8). Same sum==0 rule; invalid/empty in both samples.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM blocks 43-62 ((2*0x14+3)*8=0x158). Same sum==0 rule; invalid/empty in both samples.

slots_and_copies.name: unused_tail_block63
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM block 63; never addressed by any traced read/write (max block 62); all 0xFF in both samples.

checksums.name: header_sum16_negated_last_word
checksums.formula_detail: RAM view (each 8-byte EEPROM block byte-reversed vs .sav): checksum_word = (-sum(u16_le words 0..10)) & 0xFFFF stored at RAM offset 0x16 (u16 index 11, .sav bytes 0x11/0x10, numeric value also readable as u16_be at .sav 0x10). Valid iff sum of all 12 u16_le == 0 mod 65536. In pure .sav terms equivalently sum of u16_be at 0x00..0x17 == 0.

checksums.name: slot_sum16_negated_last_word
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_0803880c routine over 0xA0 bytes / 80 u16_le in RAM mirror; valid iff total ==0. Presumed stored word is last u16 (RAM slot+0x9E) by analogy with header (writer for a full slot was not recovered, so stored-offset assignment is static-only). Both samples are invalid/empty: stored 0xFFFF does not equal negated sum of preceding words.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 driver: saves IRQ/WAITCNT state, writes DMA3 SAD/DAD/CNT (0x040000D4 block, CNT=count|0x80000000), polls CNT busy bit 0x8000, restores state. Used both directions with 0x0D000000 EEPROM port.

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: sends start(1,1)+address bits MSB-first via DMA to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+3 units), DMA-reads 0x44 u16s, extracts 64 bits into 4 u16 stored in reverse word order. Bounds: block < *(u16*)(eeprom_desc+4); addr_bits = *(u8*)(desc+8). Direct textual caller also in FUN_08008b64 loop (callgraph lists only FUN_08045bf4).

EEPROM write one 8-byte block: expands 4 u16 + address into bitstream (write opcode/start bits), DMA count addr_bits+0x43 to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM ready bit (uRam0d000000&1) with timer-derived timeout 0x88. Bounds as read.
Wrapper: FUN_08045a94(addr,buf,retry_flag=1).
Verify: re-reads block via FUN_080459d0 and compares 4 s16; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch.

EEPROM type/config select: param 4 selects 4Kbit-class descriptor (other branches 0x40/other return 1); installs descriptor pointers used by read/write for block-count bound and address-bit width. Static-only descriptor values (Ghidra DAT placeholders).
EEPROM session open: saves WAITCNT/bus state via DAT pointers, calls FUN_08045908(4), returns (result==0). Gate for all transfers.
EEPROM session close: restores bus/WAITCNT state saved by FUN_08008c44.
Block read API: byte_addr>>3 and len>>3 give 8-byte block count; per block up to 3 retries of FUN_080459d0 (iVar3=3 loop), buf+=8, block++. Returns 1 on success.
Block write API: per 8-byte block FUN_08045a80 write + FUN_08045bf4 verify, up to 3 retries; returns 1 on success.
s16 sum: param2>>1 iterations of sVar1 += *short_ptr++ with 16-bit truncation; validity is sum==0.

Header load/flush: reads 0x18 at EEPROM 0 to stack, zeroes RAM header word11, sets it to -FUN_0803880c(header,0x18), compares 6 u32 RAM-vs-EEPROM; writes RAM header via FUN_08008bcc(0,0x18,RAM) only if different. Returns write result / 0.
Header validate: reads 0x18 at 0 into RAM buffer, requires FUN_0803880c sum==0 AND first 8 RAM bytes equal ROM template (8-byte compare loop); returns read-ok flag, clears it on magic mismatch.
Header create: memcpy 0x18 template (FUN_0802b358) into RAM header, word11 = -sum of 12 s16, FUN_08008bcc(0,0x18) writes it.
Slot load: FUN_08008b64((slot*0x14+3)*8, 0xA0, *(manager+0x18 buffer)).
Slot validate: *(bool*)(manager+0x34+slot) = (FUN_0803880c(slotbuf,0xA0)==0); returns that bool.

Save-system init (no static caller recovered - jumptable/indirect entry): allocs 0xA0 slot buffer (FUN_0802b188) at manager+0x18; if FUN_08038348 fails, FUN_08038830 creates header, FUN_08038414 zeroes slot buffer, then writes one 8-byte block at EEPROM 0x18/0xB8/0x158 (setting buffer[slot]=0xFF first); finally FUN_0803e278(manager byte+10) and FUN_08038730 loads all slots.
FUN_0802b2ec(*(manager+0x18),0,0xA0): memset slot buffer to 0 (memset, not 0xFF).

Settings-to-header mutator + flush (no static caller recovered): copies a 5-byte source record into manager/header bytes 8,9,10,13(bit7),14, forces byte 11=1, then FUN_0803cf20/FUN_080382dc/FUN_0803cf2c. Inverse unpacker is FUN_08020d58.

Load-all-slots: for slot 0..2, with FUN_0803cf20/2c guard, FUN_080387c4 + FUN_08038798; if valid and manager+0x34+slot !=0, sets manager+0x3c=slotbuf, +0x40=0 and calls func_0x08020d7c(per-slot 8-byte descriptor at stride 8); if checksum zero-flag clear, memsets that 8-byte descriptor to 0.

open_questions: Absolute RAM address of the save-manager struct (header mirror at +0x00, slot buffer ptr +0x18, valid flags +0x34): Ghidra DAT placeholders (_DAT_08038338 etc.) do not resolve to 0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx in this export, so ram_addr is null throughout.

No full-slot (0xA0) write/serialize function was recovered: only header writes and the 8-byte per-slot stamp in FUN_080383a4 call FUN_08008bcc. A populated-profile writer may be dispatched via unrecovered jumptables or be absent from the 291-function trace-guided set.
Slot payload field layout (160 bytes when valid) is completely unobserved: both samples have all three slots invalid/erased, so no progress/level/currency field can be mapped clean-room.

Semantics of the 5-byte settings record packed by FUN_08020a58/FUN_08020d58 (values 09,07,00,bit=0,01) and of header RAM18=0x0F are unknown; they are global-config candidates, not proven language/sound fields.

EEPROM descriptor values installed by FUN_08045908(4) (block-count bound at desc+4, address-bit width at desc+8) are static-only; 512-byte/64-block geometry is corroborated by the 512-byte .sav and max block 62 addressing, not by a read descriptor constant.

Entry callers of FUN_080383a4 and FUN_08020a58 were not recovered (callgraph callers [] ; tail-jumptable dispatch), so trigger contexts (boot task vs menu action) are inferred from function bodies, not caller proof.
func_0x08020d7c (per-slot descriptor builder in FUN_08038730) and FUN_0803cf20/FUN_0803cf2c guards have no recovered bodies in callgraph.json; their exact effects are unresolved.
